title: Social Mobility Adventure
welcome_lead: Can you change class in your lifetime? 🪜
meta_desc: Class & Poverty Adventure 3 — KS3 Sociology on social mobility and barriers.
final_note: You learned what social mobility is and what helps or blocks it.

concepts.def: Moving up or down the class ladder

walkthroughs.body_html:
Social mobility = changing your class through your life.

Going up = a richer, more skilled job than your parents.

Going down = the opposite.

A meritocracy means effort and talent decide success.

The UK claims to be one — but research shows children of richer parents often end up richer.

Class can stick across generations.

Things that boost mobility:

  • Good opportunities in schools.
  • Apprenticeships.
  • Mentoring.
  • Free uni places, scholarships.

Barriers include cost, location and bias. 🚧
